home.aboutRoleIntro: Moderators are trusted members of the community who help the staff team keep things running smoothly.
responsibilities: Enforce server rules fairly and consistently
Assist members with questions and issues
Keep the community welcoming and inclusive
Work closely with the wider staff team
home.requirementsIntro: We're looking for members who meet the following, before anything else.
home.ctaBody: The application takes about 10–15 minutes. Take your time and answer honestly.

responseTime.question: How long does it take to hear back about my application?
responseTime.answer: The staff team reviews applications as they come in. Response times vary depending on volume, but you can always check your status using the reference code you received.

reapply.question: Can I apply again if I'm rejected?
reapply.answer: Yes. Take some time to be more active and engaged in the community, then feel free to apply again later.

howToReport.question: How do I report a member for breaking the rules?
howToReport.answer: Use the Report a Member page. You'll need to sign in with Discord first so we can follow up with you if we need more information.

banUnfair.question: I think I was banned unfairly — what can I do?
banUnfair.answer: Submit a ban appeal through the Ban Appeal page. Explain your situation clearly and honestly — the staff team reviews every appeal.

confidentiality.question: Will my report or appeal be kept confidential?
confidentiality.answer: Reports and appeals are only visible to authorised staff. See the Privacy Notice for full details on how your information is handled.

stillNeedSupport.question: Still need support?
stillNeedSupport.answer: Contact a moderator by filling in the Support Request form with your question or issue. A staff member will reply directly to your request, and you can reply back — you'll find the conversation on your Account page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of this website — moderator applications, member reports, ban appeals, and related pages — for {serverName}. By using this site, you agree to them.

sections.title: What this site is
sections.body: This is a community-run tool for {serverName}, a Discord server. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Discord Inc. or Roblox Corporation. “Discord” and “Roblox” are trademarks of their respective owners.

sections.title: Signing in
sections.body: Some pages require signing in with your Discord account (via Discord's own login screen — we never see or store your Discord password). Staff pages require a separate account created directly by an administrator. You're responsible for keeping access to your own Discord account secure.

sections.title: What you agree to when submitting something
list: The information you submit is accurate and truthful to the best of your knowledge.
You won't submit false reports, false ban appeals, or knowingly misleading information.
You won't use the report or appeal system to harass, spam, or target another member in bad faith.
You won't attempt to disrupt, overload, or gain unauthorised access to the site or its systems.
sections.body: Submissions that violate these terms may be dismissed without review, and repeated abuse may result in your access to these systems being revoked.

sections.title: No guaranteed outcome
sections.body: Submitting a moderator application, report, or ban appeal does not guarantee any particular outcome. Decisions — acceptance, rejection, resolution, or denial — are made at the sole discretion of {serverName} staff.

sections.title: Third-party content
sections.body: The homepage displays videos from YouTube channels we don't control the operation of. Linked or embedded content belongs to its respective creators and is subject to YouTube's own terms, not these ones.

sections.title: No warranty
sections.body: This site is provided “as is,” run on a best-effort basis by community volunteers. We don't guarantee it will always be available, error-free, or uninterrupted.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time as the site changes. Continuing to use the site after an update means you accept the revised terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what information {serverName} collects across this site — moderator applications, member reports, ban appeals, and signing in with Discord — and how it is used.

whatIsCollected.title: What information is collected
whatIsCollected.applications: your Discord username, Discord User ID, age, country, timezone, activity details, moderation experience, and your written answers to the application questions. Applications don't require signing in.
whatIsCollected.signingIn: to file a report, submit a ban appeal, or check their status on the Account page, you sign in with your Discord account. Discord shares your Discord username, user ID, and avatar with us — never your Discord password, which we never see.
whatIsCollected.reports: your Discord username (as the reporter), the reported member's Discord username/ID, the category and description of what happened, and any evidence links you provide.
whatIsCollected.appeals: your Discord username and User ID, why you believe you were banned, your appeal reason, and any additional information you provide.
whatIsCollected.ipHash: Across all of these, we also record a one-way cryptographic hash of the IP address used to submit (not the raw IP) solely to prevent spam and abuse.

why.title: Why it is collected
why.body: This information is used only to evaluate moderator applications, investigate reports, review ban appeals, and — for signed-in members — to let you see the status of your own submissions. We don't collect more than is needed for these purposes, and we don't use it for advertising or share it with third parties.

howStored.title: How it is stored
howStored.body: Applications, reports, and ban appeals are stored in a secured, access-controlled database. They are never publicly accessible, and submitters cannot view anyone else's submissions. Your Discord sign-in session is managed by our authentication provider (Supabase) and is separate from Discord's own systems.

whoCanAccess.title: Who can access this data
whoCanAccess.body: Only authorised staff members of {serverName}, signed in through the staff dashboard, can view submitted applications, reports, and appeals. Access is limited to what is required to review submissions. If you're signed in with Discord, you can see the status of your own reports and appeals on the Account page — never anyone else's.

yourRights.title: Your data, your rights
yourRights.contactMethod: If you have questions about your data or wish to request its deletion, contact server administration.
yourRights.body: to ask what data we hold about you or to request that it be deleted. You can also revoke this site's access to your Discord account at any time from Discord's own Authorized Apps settings.
